verses.text: Yoilxo k'ual sk'och winhaj Pablo t'a Cesarea chi', ix k'och winhaj Ananías, winh sat sacerdote. Ajun pax jaywanh heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yet' jun winh licenciado skuch Tértulo. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Félix chi' yik syak'anb'at heb' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayik ix ik'jikot winh, ix och ijan winhaj Tértulo chi' yak'anb'at t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj Félix chi': --Ach kajal Félix, yuj wal Dios t'ayach, uuj junk'olal kaji. Te wach' yaj jantaknhej tas t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te jelan ach.
Te wach' ach. Ha t'a junjun lugar chekel yaji to wach'nhej tas tza k'ulej. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach.
Palta yik max kik'ek' niwanok tiempo t'ayach, ¿ma max ak' pawor ab'an jay b'elanh lolonel ko gana skal tik t'ayach?

Ha winhaj Pablo tik, skab' wal syail yuj winh. Ijan max techaj kuuj. Slaj ek' winh stzuntzej chaanh owal t'a skal heb' ketisraelal t'a junjun lugar. Yajal yaj winh t'a junxo makan k'ayb'ub'al, haton heb' syak'och spensar t'a jun winh aj Nazaret.

Ix yak'lej winh yik'anoch heb' manh israelok t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios yik tz'ixtaxel t'a yichanh Dios. Yuj chi' ix ko yam winh. Ko gana ix ko ch'olb'itej yaj winh, icha syal ch'anh ley aykan t'a yol ko k'ab',
palta haxo winhaj Lisias, winh coronel ix yekoch sb'a t'a ko kal. Ix b'at winh yik'elta winh t'a yol ko k'ab'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo tik to yowalil skot heb' t'ayach. Ha ach tik, syal a k'anb'an ab' t'a winhaj Pablo tik. Ichato chi' ol ilanelta to yel, manh nab'anhejok skik'kot t'a yib'anh winh, xchi winhaj Tértulo chi'.
Haxo heb' winh israel ajun yet' winh, ix yal pax heb' winh: --Te yel syal winhaj Tértulo tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yechel winh yajal chi' yik slolon winhaj Pablo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal yik winh icha tik: --Mamin Félix, a ach tik, wojtak to niwanxo tiempo ayach och juezal t'a ko nación tik. Yuj chi' tzin tzalaji swalan tas waj t'ayach.
Syal ojtakaneli to yel juntzanh ol wal tik t'ayach. Manto k'ochlaj slajchawil k'ual in k'och t'a Jerusalén, yik swal in b'a t'a Dios.

Malaj junok anima tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok. Malaj pax junok lugar b'aj tzek' wak'k'e somnaj heb' anima. Manhok t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios, manhok t'a yol spatil culto, manhok pax t'a junokxo lugar t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj jab'ok in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch tik t'a wib'anh, malaj jab'ok tas sch'ox heb' tato yel juntzanh tas syak'och heb' tik t'a wib'anh.

Yel toni, ha Dios, haton sDiosal heb' in mam wicham, a t'ay swak' em in b'a, icha syal ko k'ayb'ub'al, haton jun makanhxo k'ayb'ub'al tik syal heb'. Palta a in tik, swak'och t'a in k'ol jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés yet' jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios.
Swak' wal och Dios yipok in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak smasanil, jantaknhej heb' tojol spensar yet' pax heb' manh tojolok. Icha pax chi' sna heb' tik wet'ok.
Yuj chi' swil wal in b'a, yik max och in mul t'a Dios, yik max och pax in mul t'a heb' wetanimail.
Ay xom sjayilok ab'il manhxo in ayok ek' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Yuj chi' in k'ochxi, yik swak' jab'ok in kolwal t'a heb' meb'a' t'a skal heb' wetchonhab' tik, yik swak'an pax jab'ok in silab' t'a Dios.

Ayinek' t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios, yik swak'an in silab' chi'. Toxo ix in b'o in b'a ichataxon ko ley. Jaywannhej anima ayoch wet'ok, malaj mach nhilanochi. Malaj jab'ok owal ix in saya'. Palta hata' ix in syam juntzanh heb' israel aj Asia.
Tato ay wal in mul ix yil heb', kotokab' heb' t'a ichanh tik, ul yalokab' heb' tas in mul chi'. Oktom a wal heb' ix jawi.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh ayek' tik, yalokab' heb', tato ay in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel ayik ix in sch'olb'itan heb'. Anhej tato mul jun tik:
Ayik ay in ek' t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal chi', te chaanh ix wal icha tik: Wan in ch'olb'itaji yujto swak'och t'a in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xin chi, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Haxo winhaj Félix chi' yojtak winh sik'lab'il tas yaj sk'ayb'ub'al heb' creyente. Yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Kotokab' winhaj Lisias, winh coronel chi'. Ol ul yalan winh t'ayin tas wal yaj jun eyowal tik. Ichnhejokab' ta' skan b'ela, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh capitán to hanheja' stanhwaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Palta libre wal tz'aj winh. Syal slolon winh yet' heb' swach'k'ool, syal pax yak'an heb' tas yowalil tz'och yuj winh.

Ayxom jayeok k'ual chi', ix jax winhaj Félix t'a Cesarea chi' junelxo. Ajun ix yetb'eyum winh skuch Drusila yet'ok, israel ix. Haxo winh ix awtankot winhaj Pablo chi' yik sk'anb'ej yab' winh t'a winh tas skutej kak'anoch Jesucristo t'a ko k'ool.

Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh to yowalil wach' skutej ko b'eyb'al, sko kachanoch waan ko b'a yik max ko k'ulej chukal. Ix yalanpax winh to ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima smasanil. Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix te xiw winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --k'okb'ilxo chi' tzala'. Tato ay b'aj ol och in kolanil, ol ach wawtejxikoti, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Félix chi', snib'ej winh to ix yak' jab'ok tumin winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh t'a elk'altak, yik tz'aktajel winh yuj winh. Yuj chi' tzijtum el ix awtajkot winh yuj winh yik slolon winh yet' winh.

Chab' ab'il ix yak' winh icha chi' yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el winh t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Porcio Festo ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Haxo yik ix el winhaj Félix chi' t'a yopisio chi', ix kannhej winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol preso chi' yuj winh yik wach' stzalaj heb' israel yet' winh.
